quarterly_data.signal: Customer: the National Hockey League (NHL) named Adobe an Official Creative, Marketing and AI Partner; the partnership gives the League and its 32 Clubs access to Adobe CX Enterprise solutions, with Adobe GenStudio powering AI content production and Adobe Experience Platform plus Adobe Journey Optimizer delivering personalized fan experiences; Adobe Express with Firefly generative AI could in the future give fans creation tools. Adobe says over 20,000 brands across industries leverage its solutions to drive Customer Experience Orchestration.
